I've done some similar testing with several avatars and can corroborate with what Fizzytaco has reported.

I can confirm this issue only happens to avatars that have both the Gesture and FX layers set to Write Defaults ON.

I did find a temporary solution: If you change the Gesture layer of your avatar to Write Defaults OFF, it will fix the problem and your avatar will not be affected by this scaling bug.

@{624dc745b466065285c615e4|full_name}: Any layer that plays has a chance to randomly distort the avatar still even with this fix, tested it and while it allowed to sit, the avatar was glitching depending on states.

Setting the FX layer to Write Defaults OFF instead of the Gesture layer may also temporarily fix the problem, but like Operator said it is not guaranteed to fully fix it.

This is a problem VRChat needs to address since it affects all stations, not just chairs and beds, but even the MMD dance worlds as well.
This is also happening in the spider lair when flipping but I have only seen it on pc not on quest

We're investigating this bug!

So far, it turns out that this is due to a change in Unity, not in VRChat.

We're working with Unity to get this issue resolved.
